ImageDescription.value:
Banna Strand: Sir Roger Casement Memorial Plaques on the sides of the memorial read in both English and Irish:

At a spot on Banna Strand adjacent to here Roger Casement - Humanitarian & Irish Revolutionary Leader - Robert Monteith & a third man came ashore from a German submarine on Good- Friday morning 21st April 1916 in furthering the cause of Irish freedom

There are also cast busts of Casement and Monteith on the sides.

The Wikipedia link for Casement is here Roger_Casement
